ICS 03.120.20; 07.020MSD 03Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes rules for rounding off numerical values for the purpose of reporting results of a test, an analysis, a measurement or a calculation, and thus assisting in drafting specifications. It also makesrecommendations as to the number of figures that should be retained in course of computation.
